description: Main text gives 1,2,4,7,8,10,11; footnote attributes an alternate 1,4,7,8,10,11,12 list to Varahamihira.
Accessible Saravali transcription labels Rekhas as benefic and Bindus as malefic; mathematical equivalence is not assumed until the complete witness is checked.
Accessible passages do not establish a cross-source operational reduction contract or complete Jataka Parijata/Saravali matrices.
